_description: Source acquisition and offline scope projection lineage, plus current JSON/SQL SHA-256 records.

limitations: Bounded maker history from a public mirror, not lifetime or independently verified chain completeness.
The source has no rows before December 18 in the requested interval; those days are not zero-activity baseline days.
No baseline fills means no activity observed in this interval, not a new wallet.
All metrics must apply their scenario cutoff; the last hour is not a main-score input.
Unmapped tokens cannot be treated as distinct confirmed markets.

scope_projection.selection_rule: maker_asset_id or taker_asset_id equals a configured main-market token
scope_projection.count_origin: computed from retained rows; no new network count query
scope_projection.sql_origin: generated queries for the narrowed scope; not newly executed
